fix: createMemory now writes a memory_versions row inside the same transaction, with a per-install actor id (prefs key sync_actor) and the creation timestamp as the clock value
schema 11 adds a backfillMemoryVersions migration for memories that predate clocks

verified_after_fix.A_database: memories=2, memory_versions=1 after creating one new memory

not_verified: the 10 -> 11 backfill never ran on a real upgrade: the test package was reinstalled to ship the logging build, which wiped the pre-fix data
note: the missing version is also why the earlier end-to-end 'completed' run carried no data

backfill_verification.method: took a package that already held two memories, deleted memory_versions, set user_version=10, pushed the file back, then started the schema-11 build
backfill_verification.first_attempt: schema moved to 11 but memory_versions stayed 0; logcat showed 'backfill skip ...: getDatabase called recursively'
backfill_verification.cause: the backfill called instance helpers that reopen the database inside onUpgrade
backfill_verification.fix: listMemoryVersions now has a static overload that takes the database handle already open during the migration
